meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 给已有的访谈/播客视频叠加带时间点的图形卡片,如标题、下三分之一、数据框、引用、侧栏、画中画,按说话内容对齐时间,原视频画面不裁剪,最后通过 hyperframes 渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你说“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”或要求“package / dress up my video”,即给一段现成谈话视频加图形包装时触发;纯字幕需求会转给其它技能。

say.text: 把这段采访视频配上动态标题和下三分之一卡片,跟上语速。
say.note: Claude 会转写并生成同步卡片。

say.text: 给这个播客片段加几条数据引用卡片,风格统一。
say.note: 卡片时长按内容疏密自动调整。

say.text: 把这个访谈做成竖版 9:16,原画面不动,叠图形。
say.note: Claude 会按所选比例排布卡片。

howto.what_en: Adds timed, designed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) over an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video, synced to its transcript. The original clip plays untouched; output is an MP4 rendered via hyperframes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or ask to "package / dress up my video" — graphic packaging over an existing talking-head clip. Plain subtitles are routed elsewhere.

say_en.text: Add dynamic titles and lower-thirds to this interview, synced to the speech.
say_en.note: Claude transcribes and builds timed cards.

say_en.text: Layer a few data-quote cards over this podcast clip, consistent style.
say_en.note: Card pacing adjusts to content density.

say_en.text: Make this a 9:16 vertical cut, keep the footage intact, add graphics.
say_en.note: Claude lays out cards for your chosen aspect.
